name: ucll-mobile-starter
//: Held back from latest on purpose. expo/*, react-native, react, react-dom and @types/react follow the Expo SDK 57 matrix (see expo@57.0.28 bundledNativeModules.json) - bump them together, never individually, when you move to the next SDK. Note SDK 57 pairs with react-native 0.86.3, NOT the newer standalone 0.87.1 release. react-native-reanimated is a hard dependency of expo-router and react-native-worklets a hard dependency of reanimated, so both are pinned here to the matrix; leaving them floating pulls worklets 0.13.x, which violates expo-modules-core's peer range. @babel/* stays on v7 until babel-preset-expo peers on @babel/runtime v8. typescript stays on 6.x until Expo supports TS 7.
//overrides: Each override has a single consumer. decode-uri-component 0.5.0 (via query-string <- expo-router) and uuid 11.1.1 (via xcode <- @expo/config-plugins) are genuine vulnerability fixes - drop each once its parent updates. braces is NOT a fix: 3.0.3 is the newest release that exists and is still flagged (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm); the pin just stops npm resolving down to 2.x. The remaining npm audit highs are all unpatched-upstream build-time advisories (node-forge 1.4.0 is latest and still flagged, plus the metro/react-native chain); none of them ship in the app bundle.
